description: Does your part of setting up builds on GitHub for this app and asks the person for theirs. GitHub not connected: returns the link where the person connects it (once: a trip to github.com and back). Not linked: asks to link the app to its repository, folder and release branch (read from this checkout's origin and folder unless given). The link decides which repository's runs get the app's signing, so a person approves it on ploa.dev (an autonomous agent's links at once); pass the person the link and follow it with ploa_approval_status. Linked: Ploa commits its workflow to the release branch (a pull request when the branch is protected) once the GitHub installation has approved the Workflows permission; until then it says how the file gets there (the person adds it from the app's GitHub card, or you add it in the checkout and open a pull request; its text is in the result). And what's left. Builds nothing; run ploa_github_status after.

branch.description: The release branch builds start from. Default: the repository's default branch.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

folder.description: The app's folder in the repository ("" for its top). Default: this checkout's; on the web, the folder whose app is this one.

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub. Default: this checkout's origin (or the repository already linked).

name: ploa_github_setup
title: Set up builds on GitHub
